___TEMPLATE_INFO___.description: This is a TEMPLATE showing the structure of execution results
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.purpose: Shows what data is generated after running a workflow
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.note: Real session_*.json files are NOT committed to Git (see .gitignore)

___IMPORTANT___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE DATA: Session results may contain user prompts/queries. Never commit real session files!
___session_id___: Unique session identifier - timestamp format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS
___workflow_id___: ID of the workflow that was executed
___total_tasks___: Total number of tasks in workflow

browser_config.___adapter___: Primary adapter used (can change per task)

tasks_results.___adapter___: AI adapter that executed this task
tasks_results.prompt: Please summarize the following customer feedback in 2-3 sentences: Great product but documentation needs improvement
tasks_results.___prompt___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: The actual prompt sent to AI (may contain user queries)
tasks_results.response: The customer appreciates the product quality but suggests improving documentation. Overall positive feedback with constructive criticism.
tasks_results.___response___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: Response from AI (may contain user data in context)
tasks_results.___retries___: Number of retries before success (0 = first try)
tasks_results.___depends_on___: Task IDs this task depended on (waited for)

tasks_results.prompt: Based on this feedback, classify the sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral: Great product but documentation needs improvement
tasks_results.response: Sentiment Classification: POSITIVE (with minor negative aspect regarding documentation)
tasks_results.___dependencies_note___: This task waited for task_001 to complete first

tasks_results.___TASK_3___: Task with warning (took longer than expected)
tasks_results.prompt: List the top 5 keywords from this feedback, categorized as positive/negative: Great product but documentation needs improvement
tasks_results.response:
POSITIVE: product, quality, great
NEGATIVE: documentation, improvement, needs
warnings: Response took longer than expected (6.6s > 5s threshold)

tasks_results.prompt: Provide detailed analysis in English of this feedback: Great product but documentation needs improvement
tasks_results.response: Comprehensive analysis showing product strengths and documentation improvement opportunities...
tasks_results.___multiple_deps___: Waited for both task_002 AND task_003

error.message: Browser timeout after 120 seconds waiting for response

___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.analyze_results: Check task_results array to see each task's prompt and response
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.find_errors: Filter tasks with status='failed' to see what went wrong
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.measure_performance: Use duration_seconds to identify slow tasks
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.monitor_warnings: Check warnings array for issues that didn't cause failure
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.extract_responses: Use tasks_results[].response to get AI responses
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.debug_issues: Use metadata to understand execution environment
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.calculate_costs: Use total_response_tokens to estimate API costs

___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_1: ⚠️ Prompts may contain sensitive user queries - these files are excluded from Git!
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_2: Response field contains AI output - may include user data in context
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_3: Multiple task failures can result in status='partial'
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_4: Timeout duration set in config.json determines max wait time
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_5: Token counts are approximate - actual counts depend on tokenizer
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_7: Session files are auto-deleted based on retention policy
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_8: Real session files are exported to CSV, Markdown, and other formats
